## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-2 is stated but not proved checkably: \(J\), the ambient grading, and the boundary zero conventions are not fully defined, and the Pieri derivations of the four identities are not displayed.
- The unimodular change-of-basis matrices justify the descriptions of \(A_2\) and \(A_3\), but they do not establish the asserted enumeration of \(J_d,J_{d+1},J_{d+2}\).
- claim-3 identifies a decisive omission: case table (4) is absent. Consequently none of the required fifteen case-specific column orders, \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), integral matrices \(\mathcal C\), or literal products \(\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}\) is supplied. The five regimes in prior task research-attempt-research-plan-task-67-1 do not establish the demanded fifteen cases.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Provide the exact fifteen cases from (4), including boundary conditions and column/row conventions, and for each case display \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), an independently derived integral \(\mathcal C\), and the entrywise equality \(\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}\), together with explicit derivations of the stated degree enumeration and four Pieri identities.
